questions.question: Explain how the GLP guidelines revised over time?
questions.solution_html:
• Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) refers to a set of principles intended to ensure the quality
  • reliability, and integrity of non-clinical laboratory studies. These guidelines provide a framework
  • for the conduct, monitoring, recording, reporting, and archiving of laboratory studies, especially
  • those related to safety testing of chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and food products. Overtime the
  • GLP guidelines have evolved from basic laboratory conduct rules to comprehensive international
  • standards ensuring data integrity, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
questions.final_answer: standards ensuring data integrity, reliability, and regulatory compliance
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Why should chemicald never be pipetted by mouth?
questions.solution_html:
• Mouth pipetting not only jeopardized the health of the scientists but also compromised the
  • reliability of the results, as it was challenging to transfer precise volumes using this method.
  • Moreover, there was a risk of contaminating the sample or reagent being pipetted with
  • respiratory aerosols from the user
questions.final_answer: respiratory aerosols from the user
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write the formula for calculating normality
questions.solution_html:
• Normality (N) = Number of gram equivalents / Volume of solution (in litres) Number of gram
  • equivalents = Mass of solute (g) / Equivalent weight (g/eq)
questions.final_answer: Normality (N) = Number of gram equivalents / Volume of solution (in litres) Number of gram

questions.question: Why must you use only appropriate containers when storing acids?
questions.solution_html:
• Use only appropriate containers when storing acids because acids are highly reactive and
  • corrosive, and the wrong container can lead to dangerous chemical reactions, leaks, or even
  • explosions.
questions.final_answer: explosions
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the scope of GLP?
questions.solution_html:
• scope of GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) refers to the range of activities, studies, and facilities
  • to which GLP principles apply. GLP provides a quality framework for the organizational
  • process, personnel, facilities, equipment, and documentation involved in non-clinical laboratory
  • studies that are intended to support research or product safety assessments.
questions.final_answer: studies that are intended to support research or product safety assessments
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Name the standard solution used for pipette calibration.
questions.solution_html:
• The standard solution used for pipette calibration is typically distilled or deionized water. Water
  • is used because its density and physical properties are well known and can be accurately
  • corrected for temperature.
questions.final_answer: corrected for temperature
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write a short note on mathematical tools used in GLP?
questions.solution_html:
• In Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), mathematical tools play a vital role in ensuring the
  • accuracy, reliability, and validity of experimental data. These tools help in data analysis, error
  • checking, and result interpretation — all essential for maintaining scientific integrity and
  • regulatory compliance.
questions.final_answer: regulatory compliance
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss why is GLP still relevant today,decades after its introduction?
questions.solution_html:
• Even though Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) was introduced in the 1970s, it remains highly
  • relevant and essential in modern scientific and regulatory environments. Its principles of quality
  • integrity, and traceability are foundational to trustworthy laboratory research.
questions.final_answer: integrity, and traceability are foundational to trustworthy laboratory research
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What is the importance of eyewash station in a laboratory
questions.solution_html:
• An eyewash station is a critical safety device in any laboratory where chemicals, biological
  • materials, or particulates are handled. Its primary purpose is to protect the eyes from injury in
  • case of accidental exposure to harmful substances.
questions.final_answer: case of accidental exposure to harmful substances
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write a short essay on raw data?
questions.solution_html:
• Raw data refers to the original, unprocessed information collected during an experiment
  • observation, or study. It is the first-hand record of all measurements, observations, and facts
  • obtained directly from the source before any calculations, interpretations, or analysis are made.
  • In laboratories and research environments, raw data forms the foundation of scientific integrity
  • and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP).
questions.final_answer: and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How does proper log book maintenance prevent scientific misconduct?
questions.solution_html:
• A log book (or laboratory notebook) is a formal record of all laboratory activities, observations
  • experiments, and results. Proper maintenance of a log book is a critical safeguard against
  • scientific misconduct, as it provides transparency, accountability, and traceability for all research
  • work.
questions.final_answer: work
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write four benefits of performing regular internal audit
questions.solution_html:
• Four Benefits of Performing Regular Internal Audits1. Ensures Compliance with Standards and
  • Regulations2. Identifies Errors and Process Inefficiencies3. Enhances Data Integrity and
  • Reliability 4. Promotes Continuous Improvement and Risk Management
questions.final_answer: Reliability 4. Promotes Continuous Improvement and Risk Management
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Why is it crucial to keep lab instruments dry and free from / contaminants?
questions.solution_html:
• Keeping laboratory instruments dry and contaminant-free is essential for accuracy, safety, and
  • longevity of both the equipment and experimental results.1. Ensures Accurate and Reliable
  • Results:2. Prevents Chemical Reactions and Damage:3. Maintains Equipment Longevity4.
  • Prevents Cross-Contamination
questions.final_answer: Prevents Cross-Contamination
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Critically analyze the effectiveness of email compared to other / communication tools in research.
questions.solution_html:
• Critically analyze the effectiveness of email compared to other communication tools in
  • research.
  • Email has long been a primary mode of communication in research, but its effectiveness must be
  • weighed against other tools like instant messaging, video conferencing, collaborative platforms
  • and project management software.1. Advantages of Email in Research a) Formality and Record
  • Keeping b) Asynchronous Communication c) Attachments and Detailed Information.
questions.final_answer: Option Formality and Record

questions.question: Evaluate the role of laboratory classification (BSL-1 to BSL-4) in / ensuring biosafety.
questions.solution_html:
• Laboratory classification is the systematic categorization of laboratories based on the type of
  • work, risk level, and safety requirements. Proper classification plays a critical role in ensuring
  • safety, efficiency, regulatory compliance, and quality of research.
questions.final_answer: safety, efficiency, regulatory compliance, and quality of research
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Develop a set of guidelines for safe and ethical use of the internet in / laboratory research.
questions.solution_html:
• Develop a set of guidelines for safe and ethical use of the internet in laboratory research
  • / The guidelines for the safe and ethical use of the internet in laboratory research
  • address issues of data protection, human subjects, intellectual property (IP), and online
  • collaboration. Researchers must maintain data security, uphold confidentiality, ensure proper
  • consent, and give credit where it's due, regardless of whether their research is conducted online
  • or offline.
questions.final_answer: or offline
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the importance of result retention and archiving in GLP studies. / How does proper documentation affect the reproducibility of results?
questions.solution_html:
• proper documentation affect the reproducibility of results?
  • In Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) studies, result retention and archiving are critical for
  • ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and public safety. Proper, meticulous
  • documentation directly enables the reproducibility of scientific results by providing a complete
  • and reliable record of the study.
questions.final_answer: and reliable record of the study
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
